answer: When k identities controlled by one operator equivocate in a correlated pattern, bonded collateral penalties rise as O(k²), making each added sybil increase the swarm’s aggregate exposure. Detection can trigger an exponential multiplier in capital loss through slashing and asymmetric depreciation, so splitting stake across identities does not dilute risk. The wander, yarrow, and lotus labels may distinguish keys, but cannot hide shared behavior or restore seized collateral.
